checked_sources: Cameron, Homogeneous Permutations, structural description of the age and limit
correctness.rationale: With reversal understood on distinct pairs (equality added for the layer equivalence), the two named orders determine the ordered layers. The age and homogeneity identify realizable finite labeled extension diagrams with complete types over the pointwise named base. Old blocks cannot merge or split upon extension. Each new label either joins exactly one old block or lies in one of k+1 intervening or exterior gaps. For a fixed block of size a, j assigned labels give j! binom(a+j,j) interleavings with the old order, and the other order is forced. Each gap instead contains an ordered sequence of nonempty reversed blocks, with EGF (1−z)/(1−2z). The labeled product is (1−z)^(1−n)/(1−2z)^(k+1), with t₀=1. The first two derivatives of its logarithm at zero are n+2k+1 and n+4k+3, giving the stated t₁, t₂ and their inversion. In the popularity formulation, each canonically positioned host occurrence uniquely labels the old vertices, and its complement admits r! new labelings; this proves the exact factor. The examples (4) versus (1,1) and (1,2) versus (2,1) give the claimed counts. The n=3 minimal same-size collision follows because n≤2 has only one composition for each (n,k).
residual_risks: The recorded 48 finite cases were inspected, not rerun; they do not exhaust every possible parameter pair with combined size at most six. The proof supplies the all-arity step.

checked_sources: Frozen RESULT.md, Finding, scope and proof
value.rationale: Numerical extension counts are natural pointwise-stabilizer orbit invariants of a canonical homogeneous structure. This result characterizes exactly what every arity of that data can recover, and proves two low coefficients already recover all available structure in the invariant. The loss is not limited to exchanging the orientation of the base: (1,3) and (2,2) agree for all arities despite different multisets of layer sizes. A complete blindness classification is substantive beyond checking an isolated collision or applying a generic generating-function identity without interpretation.
residual_risks: No reconstruction or blindness result is established for the full diagrams or other homogeneous classes.
